notes.title: Exiting Early Access!
notes.notes:

During this time while we were in early access we did:

• Changed all sounds.
• The game has music.
• Changed the appearance of the game.
• Added FX effects.
• Fixed bugs in earlier versions of the game.
• New bonuses.
• Changed the appearance of achievements.
• Fixed the balance of the game.
